scope: Read-only self-service investigation of existing Homeward task; offline preparation of a separate successor.
observed_refresh_policy: every 24 hours once 25 new rows are rated up, from the base, replaying 10% of the last training rows; its exam is the first version’s 12 held-out checks
checked_controls: Adapter menu exposes switch-off/emergency-stop controls; version rollout controls do not start training.
Task page and Details expose counts, route, history, progress and IDs; no retrain/refresh action was exposed.
Training section exposes only new-example count and maximum row size; organization has no daily training limit.
Task override editor lists adapter, areas, drop_rules, exclude_rows, evals, max_rows and max_row_bytes. No refresh interval.
Advanced policy lists refresh.min_new_rows=25, refresh.min_new_fraction=0.5, cooldown_minutes=0 and replay_fraction=0.1. No task schedule editor.
Current full public docs have no management refresh/retrain endpoint. First-adapter guide explicitly documents no training retry button.
conclusion: No supported self-service mechanism found to force an early v2 of the existing adapter. Lowering a row threshold is not evidence of shortening the independent lane schedule. The current scheduler cursor and next-run time remain unknown.

workaround.description: Separate compact decision-selection task with 40 synthetic source-grounded teaching questions across eight failure families. First version would be v1 of a new adapter.
limitations: Not a v2 of the old adapter
More canonical outputs may make this task easier; any gain must be measured on this changed task and not compared directly with the old 8.3% gate
Training acceptance and timing are unconfirmed
safeguards: No automatic retries or replay of the paid batch
